rationale: Builds on the current best columnwise MLP-expansion path by combining two of the closest MLP-focused misses into one coherent quantization hypothesis: keep the last two MLPs in FP16 while dropping late attention QKV rescue, and tune the transposed `mlp.fc.weight` int8 path with a dedicated clip percentile and looser row-offset gate. The hot training loop and projection-EMA endgame stay unchanged; only the final-roundtrip-sensitive MLP family is reweighted.
title: Transpose-Tuned Tail MLP FP16 Reallocation
